comment:
* A {@link java.util.List} implementation that avoids boxing the elements into Longs if possible.
   * Does not support null elements.

methods.name: long getLong(int index)
methods.comment: Like {@link #get(int)} but more efficient in that it doesn't box the returned value.

methods.name: void addLong(long element)
methods.comment: Like {@link #add(Object)} but more efficient in that it doesn't box the element.

methods.name: long setLong(int index, long element)
methods.comment: Like {@link #set(int, Object)} but more efficient in that it doesn't box the element.

methods.name: LongList mutableCopyWithCapacity(int capacity)
methods.comment: Returns a mutable clone of this list with the specified capacity.
